I am in Quzhou County, Hebei, and on April 17, 2026 my main decision is to stay with the local `winter wheat -> summer maize` double-cropping pattern on all my land. I will not split into many crops. I know this system, the machinery service is easy to find, the grain is easy to sell, and it matches local conditions. In Quzhou, most land is already in this rotation, summer rainfall carries maize, and wheat is the crop that needs the more careful irrigation. I also do not want to gamble on a more complicated crop at my age when a steady grain rotation is safer for me to manage.

I will run the year with moderate inputs, not the old habit of pushing fertilizer too hard. The recent Quzhou demonstration fields showed that local wheat and maize can reach roughly `707-725 kg/mu` for wheat and `796-797 kg/mu` for maize with controlled nitrogen and integrated water-fertilizer management, so that is the direction I will follow. I will finish the wheat that is already standing, protect it at the key disease stage, harvest in June, return straw, then seed hybrid summer maize immediately after harvest to keep the season tight. I will use ploughing ahead of wheat, rotary tillage after wheat for maize, keep irrigation focused where it matters, and keep pesticide use to the few necessary rounds rather than spraying blindly. Sources I used: [China Agricultural University Quzhou station](https://qzsyz.cau.edu.cn/art/2024/10/8/art_46317_1039835.html), [Ministry of Agriculture wheat fertilization guidance](https://www.moa.gov.cn/xw/zxfb/202309/t20230928_6437567.htm), [Ministry of Agriculture maize water-fertilizer guidance](https://www.moa.gov.cn/xw/zxfb/202504/t20250410_6473061.htm).
